title: Aphasia
tagline: Chrome extension with on-chain verified reviews + AI recommendation agent powered by Hedera
description:
Aphasia, a decentralized reputation layer that verifies online reviews using verifiable credentials and zero-knowledge proofs. It starts as a Chrome extension, allowing users to instantly see verified reviews and trust scores across any website, sourced from decentralized identity systems and social attestations rather than opaque platforms. Aphasia brings cryptographic verification and AI-powered curation to online reviews, combining Hedera's blockchain infrastructure with advanced AI agents to create a universal layer of trust for the open web.

Three-Tier Verification System
Level 1 - Email Verification (Off-chain, Free)
Basic human verification through email validation. Stops simple bots and spam. Trust Score: 30/100.
Level 2 - Social Reputation (Off-chain, Free)
OAuth integration with LinkedIn, Twitter/X, and Google. Our reputation scoring algorithm analyzes account age, follower count, and activity patterns to prevent sockpuppets. Trust Score: 60-80/100.
Level 3 - Unique Human (On-chain, Verified by Hedera)
Biometric verification via Self Protocol using zero-knowledge proofs. Each verification is attested through our VerificationRegistry smart contract on Hedera EVM, with nullifiers stored on-chain to cryptographically guarantee one person equals one account. HCS messages provide an immutable backup. Trust Score: 95/100.
On-Chain Review Attestations
Reviews from Level 3 verified users are attested using our ReviewAttestation smart contract deployed on Hedera EVM. Each attestation includes:

Review ID and product identifier
IPFS hash of review content
Reviewer's DID (decentralized identifier)
Rating and timestamp
HCS sequence number

Users can verify any review with one click, seeing the complete chain of proof: IPFS content → HCS message → Smart contract attestation → Hashscan explorer.
AI Recommendation Agent
Powered by Hedera Agent Kit, our AI agent understands natural language queries like "What's the best laptop under $1000?" and provides curated recommendations based on:

Verified review analysis across all products
Trust score weighting (Level 3 reviews weighted higher)
Sentiment analysis and review quality
Recency and relevance factors

All agent queries and responses are logged to HCS for transparency and auditability. This creates a decentralized record of AI decision-making.
How Users Experience Aphasia

Install Chrome extension (5 seconds)
Browse any website - Amazon, Airbnb, eBay, anywhere with reviews
See trust scores overlaid automatically on product pages
Read verified reviews with clear trust badges (Level 1/2/3)
Ask the AI agent anything: "Find me the best wireless earbuds for running"
Verify on-chain with one click to see cryptographic proof
Write your own reviews and build portable reputation across platforms

Innovation & Impact
Aphasia represents a paradigm shift in online trust:

Hybrid Architecture - Off-chain for scale (Level 1-2), on-chain for truth (Level 3)
Progressive Verification - Users choose their trust level, no forced complexity
AI + Blockchain Synergy - Verifiable data meets intelligent curation
Universal Compatibility - Works on any website via Chrome extension
Privacy-Preserving - Zero-knowledge proofs protect user identity

We're not just fighting fake reviews. We're building the infrastructure for verifiable reputation in the age of AI.

how_its_made:
Technology Stack
Frontend (Chrome Extension):
React 18 + TypeScript + Vite
Background service worker for API calls
Chrome Extension Manifest V3

Backend API:
Node.js + Express + TypeScript
PostgreSQL (Neon serverless) + Prisma ORM
JWT authentication
RESTful API design

Blockchain (Hedera):
Smart Contracts: Solidity 0.8.24 deployed on Hedera EVM
Development: Hardhat 3.0 (using new Solidity test features)
Libraries: ethers.js v6 for contract interaction
Services: HCS for message submission, Mirror Node API for queries

Storage:
IPFS (Pinata) for review content and images
PostgreSQL for fast querying and caching
Hybrid approach: off-chain for speed, on-chain for proof

Verification:
Self Protocol for biometric verification (Level 3)
OAuth 2.0 for social verification (Level 2)
Custom email verification (Level 1)
